description: Dream cycle step-02 salience scoring parser missed block-form tags where '-' has no leading whitespace (e.g., 'tags:\n- daily-review\n- chief'). Initial run marked 163 of 172 files as no_tags, collapsing score distribution to 0:163. Detected via distribution regression vs prior cycle (11 no_tags baseline).
correction:
Updated block-form tag regex from '^tags:\s*
((?:\s+-\s+.+
?)+)' to '^tags:\s*
((?:[ 	]*-[ 	]+.+
?)+)' to accept both indented and unindented dash lines. Re-ran step-02 cleanly: 161 files_with_tags, 11 no_tags. Score distribution restored to expected 0:20, 1:2, 2:1, 3:2, 4:1, 5:1, 6:2, 8:4, 9:2, 10:137.
systemic_fix: Promote step-02 parser to systems/dream-cycle/ so tag-parsing regex isn't rebuilt inline each cycle. Same class as err-20260703T081410-XDIYNH and err-20260705T132715-AQ387E — inline scripts recreate parsing logic each run and drift from the corpus's actual frontmatter conventions.
